description: This file is a shell script that sets up and tests concurrent git-svn dcommit operations, including simulating SVN hooks to emulate failures or concurrent commits as part of a test suite.

methods.name: next_N
methods.description: Increments the counter variable N used to differentiate test runs.

methods.name: setup_hook
methods.description: Configures SVN hooks (pre-commit or post-commit) to simulate failures or concurrent commits during testing.

methods.name: check_contents
methods.description: Checks that the contents of files in the working directory and SVN working copy are synchronized as expected.

methods.name: delete_first_line
methods.description: Removes the first line from a specified file, used in testing concurrent changes.
